title: The Boxed Rook
setup: Black's rook on a8 has its own pawn on a7 beneath it and its own bishop on b8 right beside it.
hint: That rook has no move at all. Find the long diagonal that reaches into the corner it is stuck in.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bf3}} hits a8 down the h1-a8 diagonal and the rook has nowhere: a7 is Black's pawn, b8 its bishop. Nothing can defend a8, and the dark-squared bishop can never block a light-squared diagonal, so the rook is simply lost.
